about_the_game:
Beat'em Up, Eat'em Up

[Gluttony] is a 2D action roguelike with a classic cartoon art style, built on the unique concept of "fighting by eating." 

Become a cute demon of gluttony and continuously invade the FoodHell, home of the FoodDevils, to ultimately claim the throne of Food Hell for yourself.

Unique combat system

Dodge the onslaught of approaching Food Devils, devour them to steal their abilities, and once your stomach is full, unleash it all in a single, explosive burst.

Attack enemies to wear down their health, then dash into weakened foes to swallow them in one bite.

Depending on the type of FoodDevil you devour, you'll acquire various combat abilities known as FoodPowers. Fire french fries like a gatling gun, or plant explosive cola cans like landmines.

When your Satiety is maxed out from devouring enemies, you'll instantly activate a powerful ultimate move, the Belly Burst. Be warned, as using it will consume all your Food Powers, leaving your character weakened, so use it wisely.

Upgrade to complete the build

Customize your character build by selecting a random upgrade option that appears after clearing each stage.

Fire a laser instead of a gatling gun, spread corruption among your enemies, or even become an immortal zombie.

You can also acquire special upgrades by making deals with allies you occasionally encounter.

Permanent reinforcement at the base

Remember to stop by at your base when the difficulty feels too high.

Permanently enhance your character by trading resources obtained during combat with your allies.

Increase your character's base stats with Devil's Meat, acquired through regular stages, or unlock skills that strengthen your Food Powers with Boss Coins, earned by defeating bosses.
